fusions.name: Hush
fusions.desc: Speaks a word at the first enemy in reach that deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Droning Lecture
fusions.desc: A monotone recitation that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited at Leisure
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spoken Ward
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and you gain a shield of 6% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
